title: Receipt series by field
description: Number receipts from a separate counter for each value of a learner field, for example one series per branch. Learners who match no series use the default numbering above.

enable.label: Number receipts by a learner field
enable.hint: Off by default. When on, each enrolment's first payment asks for the field, and every later receipt of that course stays in the same series.

field.label: Field that picks the series
field.hint: Only fields with a list of options can be used.

policy.ask: Ask for it when the first payment of an enrolment is recorded
policy.hint: Asked once per course. Later installments, whoever records them, and online payments use the same series.

errors.field: Choose the field that picks the series.
errors.values: Series {{n}}: tick at least one value.
